description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340012638289 BRACKET,ANGLE: Line 0001 Qty 56 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0155 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
